title: The release tests exercise the race guards in the shipped profile
description: the release tests exercise the race guards in the shipped profile
no_spec_change_rationale: Adds release-runnable unit tests for three existing TOCTOU guards and a release-candidate lane step; no guard behavior or contract changes
